slogan: Showcase your creations the professional way

phaseDesc.form: Create your blogger account to get started
phaseDesc.role: Choose your content focus and the system will preset the matching modules
phaseDesc.storage: Choose how files are stored. You can skip this and configure it later
phaseDesc.theme: Fetch the official default theme and finish the blog appearance setup in one click

form.initCodePlaceholder: Enter the deployment key from the official email

role.title: What kind of blog do you want to build?
role.desc: Choose your content focus (multiple allowed). The system will preset backend modules accordingly, and you can adjust them anytime in Module Management.
role.presetTitle: Modules to be enabled for you

roles.techDesc: Write technical articles and showcase projects and open-source work
roles.petDesc: Photo albums and portfolio for your furry friends
roles.gamingDesc: Game library, playtime and short reviews
roles.lifestyleDesc: Record life with articles and the media library. No dedicated modules for now
roles.allDesc: Enable all content modules, adjustable anytime

storage.title: Configure Object Storage
storage.desc: Choose where uploaded images, videos and other assets are stored. You can skip this and configure it anytime in the admin console.

theme.title: Initialize Blog Appearance
theme.desc: Enter the NovaBlog official URL and sign in to your official account. The default theme will be fetched and enabled automatically (this URL is the unified entry for community feeds and the theme marketplace).
theme.skip: Skip and install later on the theme page
